observation: Short-form creators editing talking-head clips want the 'um's and 'uh's gone, not only the silences: filler-word removal is a headline feature in this month's caption and jump-cut tool roundups (OpusClip's filler-word remover list, 2026; Captions' and Kapwing's filler-word guides; CapCut detects fillers during caption generation), and the guides note fillers also litter auto-captions. funkbox's new video cutplan (#55) proposes long pauses and repeated takes for approval, but a spoken 'um' between two words is neither, so it stays in the cut.
suggestion: Add filler words to `funkbox video cutplan` / video_cutplan: each word in words.json that matches a filler list (default um, uh, uhm, er, erm, ah, hmm; `fillers=[...]` to change it, `fillers=[]` to turn it off) is proposed for removal with the reason 'filler: um', merged with the pause and retake spans, so the approved plan renders without them. Unit tests on a synthetic words.json and a docs line in docs/video.md.
would_enable: A how-to or tip promo on cleaning a talking-head take: transcribe, cutplan proposes pauses, a retake and three 'um's, approve, render.
